title: Heart Sutra 7 San Miguel de Allende
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk's main teaching encourages mindfulness and awareness to avoid creating unnecessary separations and divisions in ourselves and others by recognizing how language and categorization can distort our view of reality. Our minds often make assumptions about others and ourselves, leading to miscommunications and misunderstandings, but this understanding is not meant to be rigid or dogmatic, rather a flexible approach to wisdom that allows us to cultivate curiosity, openness, and non-attachment. By embracing simplicity and mystery, we can soften our attachment to concepts and perceptions and investigate our true experience moment by moment.
